question: What are the key risks for Diginex?

beats.line: Diginex faces a fragmented reporting landscape across jurisdictions and industries.
beats.headline: FRAGMENTED RULES
beats.action: Torn paper documents scatter across a paper map and settle unevenly.

beats.line: Data quality, reliability and comparability pose significant challenges.
beats.headline: DATA RELIABILITY
beats.action: The opening chip slides off the top edge as the scattered documents stack into one sheet; a paper magnifying lens lowers over it and holds.

beats.line: Fail on auditable data, and credibility with clients could suffer.
beats.headline: CREDIBILITY AT RISK
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the lens folds into a paper stamp; it presses a document and the sheet cracks down the middle.

beats.line: Definitions and frameworks keep shifting as regulation evolves.
beats.headline: SHIFTING FRAMEWORKS
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the cracked document splits into sliding paper panels; a ribbon threads between them and pulls them out of line.

beats.line: The share price has fallen sharply, shifting focus to delivery.
beats.headline: SHARE PRICE FALL
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the sliding panels close into a paper chart; a torn-paper arrow cuts down across it and stops low.

beats.line: Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent, to two million dollars.
beats.headline: +293% TO $2.0M
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the down arrow inverts into a rising paper bar; paper coins stack along its top edge and hold.

beats.line: But the market questions how repeatable that growth really is.
beats.headline: ONE-OFF VS SAAS
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the rising bar splits into two paper columns; a paper hand enters and tilts one column back and forth.

beats.line: Strategy leans on acquisitions, so execution is the key risk.
beats.headline: EXECUTION RISK
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the two columns fold into interlocking paper blocks; tape pieces press across the seam and hold it shut.

beats.line: Slow integration of Resulticks could keep investor confidence weak.
beats.headline: SLOW INTEGRATION
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the taped seam unrolls into a calendar strip; one tape edge peels back and curls away.

beats.line: Adoption stays uneven, so sales cycles may lengthen, slowing growth.
beats.headline: LONGER SALES CYCLES
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the peeling strip stretches into a long paper track; a cutout vehicle crawls partway along it and halts.

beats.line: Diginex must educate the market and demonstrate return on investment.
beats.headline: PROVE ROI
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the stretched track folds into a paper ledger; a paper hand enters and taps its final line.
